summary: Frontend-only test for Events archive restructure. Verified: Navbar Events link (desktop nav-events and mobile-nav-events) now routes to /events on both desktop and mobile viewports. /events archive page renders with data-testid='page-events-archive' and shows all 3 chapter cards in correct reverse-chronological order: Chapter 03 Abhav Ke Bhav (badge 'Now booking', orange highlighted, links to /supper-club/when-there-wasnt-enough), Chapter 02 Barsaat (badge 'Series concluded', links to /supper-club/barsaat), Chapter 01 Naani Ghar (badge 'Series concluded', links to /supper-club/naani-ghar). Whole card is a Link and navigates correctly (verified Abhav Ke Bhav click routes to WTWE page). Homepage /#events section (events-section testid) is intact with new events-view-archive-link routing to /events. Barsaat page: hero eyebrow reads 'Second chapter · Concluded' (CMS-driven), hero body mentions Gujarat/Rajasthan/Bengali. barsaat-all-concepts link routes to /events. barsaat-rajneesh section describes rain on tin roof, train announcement, house music, tempo shifts, and dish spice/intensity. Dates section gracefully handles no upcoming dates. Naani Ghar page: hero mentions Nani/homecoming, naani-chef-note and naani-approach sections render with all 3 pillar cards (naani-approach-0 'A home, finally', naani-approach-1 'Nani's kitchen, revisited', naani-approach-2 'Rebuilt, not reproduced'). naani-all-concepts link routes to /events. Menu items preserved (Cucumber Ashgourd Soda, Dahi Bhalla verified). /menus/barsaat menu page loads with all 10 courses unchanged (Khicchu, Fries from Gujrat, Corn Chaat, Thepla, Dal Bhaat, Sev Ussal, Fermented Jamun, Masala Chai, Malai Toast all present). 53/54 checks passed; the single 'FAIL' was a false positive in my selector (^= prefix also matched parent 'archive-chapter-list' container so counted 4 instead of 3 — the 3 actual cards each pass individually).
critical_code_review_comments: EventsArchive.jsx CHAPTERS array is hardcoded — acceptable per requirements (static list, no backend calls), but future chapters will require code change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Events archive restructure fully verified. All 3 chapter cards, all nav routes (desktop + mobile), Barsaat CMS-driven hero/rajneesh copy, and Naani Ghar chef_note/approach sections work. Menus for Barsaat and Naani Ghar unchanged. No regressions detected.
